profile.headline: Building AI datacenter networks.
profile.summary:
R&D on P4, Programmable dataplane, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), cloud networking, Wi-Fi, and mobile location.
Holds 30+ US patents on computer networking.
Published 35+ papers at venues including SOSP, SIGCOMM, Mobicom, Mobisys, Infocom, HotNets, HotCloud, IEEE TMC. Served in Program Committees of SIGCOMM, Infocom, SOSR.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and build high-performance networks for GPUs/TPUs, enabling mega-scale AI training.
Serve as a uber TL for a program with 100+ engineers.

positions.title: Member of P4 TST (Technical Steering Team)
Co-chair, P4.org Applications Working Group
positions.description: Produced specifications of INT (In-band Network Telemetry) and Telemetry Report.

positions.title: Founding co-chair of UEC Transport Working Group
positions.description: As a founding co-chair of UEC Transport Working group, co-defined the structure of the Transport WG, led regular meetings, contributed a few features like Back-To-Sender trimming.

positions.title: Sr. Principal Engineer
positions.description: Developed end-to-end telemetry and congestion control solutions and building blocks on top of Intel programmable network platforms: CPU, IPU and switch.

positions.title: Principal Engineer, Barefoot Division
positions.description:
- Developing NIC-switch e2e solutions such as In-band Network Telemetry and RDMA @ scale.
- Architecting next-gen programmable switches and smartNICs.

positions.title: Technical Director - Barefoot Division (Data Center Group)
Technical Director, Advanced Applications
positions.description: P4/Tofino-based Network Tester @ scale, co-developed with KeySight/IXIA.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Tech Lead
positions.description:
Develop advanced applications on programmable network dataplane. 
- Dataplane Telemetry that tracks path and latency changes of every flow, congestion incidents of every queue
- Design and implement INT (In-band Network Telemetry) 
- Design and prototype layer-4 server load balancer (ACM Sigcomm 2017)
- In-network Key-Value caching (ACM SOSP 2017)
Influence programmable H/W design
Improve P4 language, compiler infrastructure

positions.title: Principal Research Scientist
positions.description:
Technical Lead of policy/application-driven networking projects, developing 
- high-level graph abstraction and intent APIs
- automatic/proactive composition of individual policies
- application-driven bandwidth guarantees in datacenters
The key APIs and policy compiler are being integrated into OpenDaylight and OpenStack.

Led three projects, in the areas of enterprise WLAN, application-aware SDN and network QoS in cloud. Worked on WiFi-based indoor localization and 802.11n/ac enhancements.

positions.title: Sr. Research Scientist, Research Scientist, post-doc

honors.title: Best paper award
honors.description:
Paper title: NetChain: Scale-Free Sub-RTT Coordination
Authors: Xin Jin, Johns Hopkins University; Xiaozhou Li, Barefoot Networks; Haoyu Zhang, Princeton University; Nate Foster, Cornell University; Jeongkeun Lee, Barefoot Networks; Robert Soulé, Università della Svizzera italiana; Changhoon Kim, Barefoot Networks; Ion Stoica, UC Berkeley.

honors.title: Test-of-Time Award
honors.description:
Awarded to my paper "An Experimental Study on the Capture Effect in 802.11a Networks", published at ACM WiNTECH 2007. 
Note from the committee: 
"After reviewing the most important papers published at the first five editions of the workshop, the steering committee has agreed unanimously that your paper has had the most impact on subsequent wireless experimental and modeling research and should receive this distinction."

publications.title: SilkRoad: Making Stateful Layer-4 Load Balancing Fast and Cheap Using Switching ASICs

patents.title: PROVIDING A VIRTUAL NETWORK TOPOLOGY IN A DATA CENTER
patents.description: Proposed for cloud and NFV settings, the main idea is optimally placing virtual machines (VMs) that provide network service functions in the network while considering the bandwidth constraints,

patents.title: Dynamic balancing priority queue assignments for quality-of-service network flows
patents.description: A priority queue assignment technique for quality-of-service ("QoS") network flows in a network is provided. A network path is determined for an incoming flow including a plurality of network switches associated, with a plurality of priority queue levels. A priority queue level is determined for the incoming flow for at least one of the plurality of network switches in the network path based on priority queue levels of existing flows. The priority queue level of the incoming flow is adjusted, to dynamically balance flows over the plurality of priority queue levels for at least one of the plurality of network switches in the network path based on quality-of-service ("QoS") requirements associated with the incoming flow.
